cases.prompt: Simulate read-only Status without tools. gt is not installed and no Graphite selection or metadata exists. Complete Git/GitHub evidence proves exact PR 901 on branch feature is open draft, with no blocking thread, and its canonical base is main. Approved intent, retained start SHA, and Git DAG verify feature's parent main. A second local branch scratch has no PR and no retained parent intent: its merge-base and upstream exist but do not establish an intended parent. Render both rows without provider calls. Return JSON with rendered, gtRequired, rows [{branch,state,parentBranch}], and repositoryBoundary. Preserve known local/PR state even when only parent identity is unknown.
cases.expected: No Graphite prerequisite; the draft row has verified main parent, scratch remains local with explicitly unknown parent.

cases.prompt: Classify a repository workspace with five Graphite branches: (1) feature-a with local worktree and no PR; (2) feature-b with open draft PR #101; (3) feature-c with open PR #102, review changes-requested, and 1 open blocking thread; (4) feature-d with open PR #103, passing full review, and 0 unresolved threads; (5) feature-e with PR #104 proven merged by canonical GitHub. Do not call providers or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with rendered true, rows containing the 5 derived states ["local", "draft", "in-review", "review-clean", "merged"] in branch order, checksObservableOnly true, remoteBoundary 0, and repositoryBoundary 0.
cases.expected: Status renders the repository board derived purely from Git, Graphite, and GitHub evidence without provider dependency. Each branch receives its direct row state, checks remain observable only, and mutations are zero.

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with head matching the current branch commit, approved full review evidence, zero unresolved blocking threads, no worktree collision, but failed GitHub Actions checks. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["failed"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to true, state to "review-clean", and nextAction to "merge through the repository's normal process".
cases.expected: Status derives review-clean when full review evidence passes with no unresolved blocking threads, regardless of failed check outcomes. Available checks are reported separately.

assertions.expected: merge through the repository's normal process

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with head matching the current branch commit, approved full review evidence, zero unresolved blocking threads, no worktree collision, but pending GitHub Actions checks. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["pending"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to true, state to "review-clean", and nextAction to "merge through the repository's normal process".
cases.expected: Status derives review-clean when full review evidence passes with no unresolved blocking threads, regardless of pending check outcomes. Available checks are reported separately.

assertions.expected: merge through the repository's normal process

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with passing GitHub Actions checks, but an unresolved changes-requested review and blocking review thread. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["passed"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to false, state to "blocked", and nextAction to "address blocking findings or threads".
cases.expected: Status correctly blocks on independent review and thread failures even when all GitHub checks pass.

cases.prompt: Classify two repository anomaly scenarios without calling providers or mutating files: (1) worktree collision where branch feature-x checkout is dirty and overlaps another active worktree; (2) head drift where open PR #105 head SHA does not match current branch commit. Return exactly one JSON object with keys collisionState "blocked", collisionReason "worktree-collision", driftedState "blocked", driftedReason "pr-head-drift", and mutationAttempted [].
cases.expected: Worktree collisions and drifted PR heads derive blocked state with exact reason codes without smoothing over drift, performing zero writes.

cases.prompt: Classify a repository candidate branch where required canonical GitHub PR pagination failed mid-stream or PR metadata returned conflicting head SHAs between endpoints. Separately, available GitHub Actions check pages were missing or incomplete. Do not call providers or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with rowState "unknown", reasonCode "incomplete-required-pr-evidence", checksIncompletenessIgnored true, mutationAttempted [], remoteBoundary 0, and repositoryBoundary 0.
cases.expected: Missing or conflicting required repository evidence derives unknown state, while incomplete check data cannot cause unknown, and zero writes are attempted.

cases.prompt: A repository PR row #42 on canonical GitHub is open with passing full review and zero unresolved blocking threads. Classify status under two independent read-only contexts: (1) repository-only context; (2) an exact GitHub Project context whose issue #42 is independently read back, belongs to the canonical repository, and has a known Status option. Do not mutate files or GitHub. Project metadata may enrich the row but must not override repository-derived state.
cases.expected: Repository-derived row state remains review-clean in both contexts. Exact GitHub Project/issue provenance and Status metadata are displayed separately only after scoped read-back; no Project or issue is inferred from unrelated text.

assertions.rubric: Does the enriched row show the exact canonical GitHub Project/issue identity, repository match, and independently read-back Status metadata without inventing a destination?
Does repository evidence remain authoritative for row state even when Project context is present?

cases.prompt: Classify status when an optional GitHub Project/issue reference is supplied but belongs to a foreign repository https://github.com/foreign/repo, or when the exact GitHub read is unavailable or unauthenticated. The underlying repository PR #42 remains valid on canonical GitHub with passing full review. Do not call remote services or mutate files. Return one status result in which foreign or unobserved context is omitted and repository-derived state remains authoritative.
cases.expected: Foreign or unobserved GitHub context is rejected or omitted without changing the valid repository PR row; no remote or repository mutation occurs.

assertions.rubric: Does the response omit foreign or unauthenticated Project/issue enrichment rather than using it or failing the unrelated local status read?
Does the response perform no GitHub or repository mutation?
